# Garrett Motion’s Oil-Free Centrifugal Compressor Technology Advances Data Center Cooling Applications


*Enabling Multistack’s next-generation CRAC-DX (direct expansion computer room air conditioning) cooling platforms in Asia-Pacific*


**PLYMOUTH, MI. and ROLLE, Switzerland, October 29, 2026 –** Garrett Motion Inc. (Nasdaq: GTX), a global leader in differentiated turbocharging and electrification technologies for automotive and industrial applications, today announced that Multistack has selected Garrett’s oil-free centrifugal compressor technology for its next-generation data center cooling platforms in Asia-Pacific.


The award marks another step in Garrett’s expansion into industrial thermal management. Garrett’s technology will be integrated into Multistack’s next-generation CRAC-DX (direct expansion computer room air conditioning) for data centers, with start of production planned for the second half of 2027. Multistack is a recognized provider of modular chiller and cooling solutions for commercial, industrial and data center applications.


*“As AI and digital infrastructure grow, the need for efficient and reliable cooling is becoming increasingly critical,” said* **Olivier Rabiller, President and CEO of Garrett Motion.** *“Our high-speed, oil-free centrifugal compressor technology helps deliver greater energy efficiency, reliability and system performance. Together with Multistack, we look forward to advancing the next generation of sustainable cooling solutions.”*


Engineered for industrial HVAC and cooling applications, Garrett’s oil-free centrifugal compressor combines high-speed centrifugal compression and oil-free air foil bearing technology to deliver high efficiency and reliability while reducing maintenance requirements. Operating at more than 90,000 RPM, the compressor supports the adoption of next-generation low-GWP refrigerants. Its compact design is more than 50% smaller and 80% lighter than conventional solutions, helping lower total cost of ownership while delivering sustainability benefits.

**About Garrett Motion Inc.**


A differentiated technology leader, Garrett Motion has a 70-year history of innovation in the automotive sector (cars, trucks) and beyond (off-highway equipment, marine, power generators). Its well-recognized expertise in turbocharging has enabled significant reductions in engine size, fuel consumption, and CO2 emissions. Garrett is committed to advancing turbo applications while leveraging its unique technology solutions, such as fuel cell compressors for hydrogen fuel cell vehicles, as well as electric propulsion and thermal management systems for automotive and industrial applications. Garrett has six R&D centers, 13 manufacturing facilities and a team of more than 8,700 employees in more than 20 countries.
